title: DISTRIBUTIONALLY ROBUST MODELS WITH PARAMETRIC LIKELIHOOD RATIOS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating robust (worst-group) accuracy on a toxicity detection dataset (FDCL18) partitioned by dialectal annotations that align closely with self-reported race, where minority dialects are often disproportionately misclassified.

Measuring worst-group accuracy on a facial attribute classification task (CelebA) across subgroups formed by the intersection of the target label (hair color) and gender, to test if the model relies on the spurious correlation between gender and hair color in the training data.

Evaluating model robustness against non-demographic distributional shifts and artifact biases by measuring worst-group accuracy on datasets with confounding variables, such as background contexts in images (Waterbirds) and synthetic distractor tokens in text (BiasedSST).
